additional_test_sources.full_recovery_controller:
import json,subprocess,resource,time,pathlib
start=time.monotonic();out=subprocess.run(['node','--max-old-space-size=128','--expose-gc','/tmp/history-integration-recovery.cjs'],capture_output=True,text=True)
r={'name':'full 152-snapshot old-format recovery candidate','elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,2),'exit_code':out.returncode,'stderr':out.stderr}
if out.returncode==0:
 r.update(json.loads(out.stdout));r['conservative_peak_rss_bytes']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss+r['peak_rss_bytes'];r['passed']=r['conservative_peak_rss_bytes']<768*1024**2 and r['result']['approval']['approved']==False
else:r['passed']=False
pathlib.Path('/tmp/history-integration-recovery-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ['result']}),flush=True)
assert r['passed']
